faq.name: What’s included in the free security audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: We review key Microsoft 365 risk areas (MFA, forwarding, conditional access, admin roles, connected apps, SharePoint/OneDrive permissions, anti‑phishing, retention and logs) and deliver a prioritized report.

faq.name: How long does a Microsoft 365 migration take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your size and current setup. We plan the migration to minimize impact and keep operations running.
